paragraphs: R. Chanina bar Abbahu. His father sent him to Caesarea to study, but he was burying the dead. His father sent to him, “Was it because there are no graves in Tiberias that I sent you there?” [Both cited Jerusalem passages have him sent to Tiberias, with Caesarea in the rebuke.]: Jerusalem Talmud, end of Elu Overin; Chagigah, chapter 1, halakhah 7. “R. Chizkiyah said: R. Chanina son of R. Abbahu said”—Kiddushin 33b. R. Chizkiyah in R. Avdimi of Chaifa's name: Jerusalem Bikkurim, last chapter.
